book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: الملك سألني عن بغداد وعن الخليفة.
sentences.en: The king asked me about Baghdad and about the caliph.

sentences.ar: حكيت له عن المدينة وعن سوقها.
sentences.en: I told him about the city and its market.

sentences.ar: قال لي: بدي أبعت مكتوب وهدية.
sentences.en: He said to me: I want to send a letter and a gift.
And you are the one who will deliver them.

sentences.ar: أعطاني مكتوب مكتوب على جلد غالي.
sentences.en: He gave me a letter written on costly leather.
I returned to Baghdad and delivered the letter with my own hand.

sentences.ar: الخليفة سمع قصتي وضحك من العجب.
sentences.en: The caliph heard my story and laughed in wonder.
